Contains information from OpenStreetMap, which is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
The OSM-derived geometry portions are available under ODbL 1.0. Bugatti, Brands Hatch Indy, Misano, Nürburgring and Bathurst use adapted OSM geometry. Circuit de la Sarthe, Fuji, Daytona and Paul Ricard GT/Bol d’Or use adapted OSM geometry from Track Atlas (https://github.com/tobi/track-atlas). No sim-derived corner layers from Track Atlas are included.
Brands Hatch GP and Magny-Cours outlines adapted from GameDev Toolkit global-motorsport-circuits-json (https://github.com/GameDev-Toolkit/global-motorsport-circuits-json), Apache License 2.0.
The independent outlines were aligned with published circuit diagrams. Their rotations, corner placement and reduced display geometry were adapted for RaceDay.

formula1Sources.scope: 2026 and 2027 F1 calendars, plus supported recent and historic F1 layouts audited here
formula1Sources.notes: Coordinates identify a point on or near the race venue for local weather. Tyre stress and overtaking difficulty are editorial ratings.

overcut.note: Approximate relief sampled by Overcut from Copernicus WorldDEM-30. FIA corner counts and existing published elevation figures take precedence.

indyCarSources.mapNotes: Simplified outlines for app display. Most shapes and turn positions were digitized from event maps. Indianapolis road, Long Beach, Road America and Laguna Seca use Track Atlas geographic outlines. Timing sectors are shown only when supplied by a verified profile. Banking is the maximum corner banking.

imsaSources.scope: IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship circuits for 2026 and 2027, including Daytona road course for the Roar.
imsaSources.notes: Display outlines use geographic centerlines when available. Timing boundaries use the published three-sector distances on WeatherTech-only profiles. Shared profiles use the circuit corner numbering and the official finish line. Chicane sub-turns remain part of their numbered turn.

dtmSources.notes: DTM car-racing variants. The Lausitzring profile is the short course with the infield Turn 1. Circuit routes use OpenStreetMap centerlines with circuit diagrams defining corner positions. Zandvoort and the Red Bull Ring use their existing maps.

n-rburgring-sprint.section: Nürburgring Sprint, 3.629 km; existing layout verified against official DTM race result.

motoGPSources.notes: Motorcycle course geometry and corner labels checked against Michelin race guides and circuit publications. Start/finish and the three intermediate timing lines use MotoGP/Tissot circuit information. Buenos Aires and Adelaide are planned 2027 configurations without published timing lines.

oulton-park-international.notes: BSB TSL numbering (16), including Brittens and Hislops/Knickerbrook. The venue counts some bends differently in its generic specification.

knockhill-racing-circuit.notes: Clockwise international racing route; measured finish line ahead of the grid start marker.

cadwell-park-circuit.notes: BSB timing map numbering (18); venue general specifications count 19. Bike-side chicane between Mansfield and The Mountain.

motul-tt-assen.notes: The BSB round uses the same Grand Prix route and Geert Timmer chicane. Existing map reused.

btccBsbSources.notes: OSM centerlines reproduce the road used for each layout and were checked against circuit maps and TSL race documents. Lengths prefer the 2026 race timing designation over rounded venue figures. Timing sectors are provided where the lap markers match the available race timing reference. Where published corner conventions differ and the supported count could not be matched to a numbered race map, only the published count is shown.

charlotte-motor-speedway.notes: Smoothed racing-surface centerline from georeferenced USGS NAIP aerial imagery; painted start/finish checked against the facility map. Pit lane and alternate course connections are excluded.

indianapolis-raceway-park.notes: NASCAR Truck schedule lists 7.5° in the corners. iRacing documents 12° on the upper line; bankingDegrees is the maximum.

kansas-speedway.notes: Circuit operator lists current progressive banking at 17–20° after the 2012 reconfiguration. The Cup Flip card still lists 15°.

las-vegas-motor-speedway.notes: Smoothed racing-surface centerline from georeferenced USGS NAIP aerial imagery; painted start/finish checked against the facility map. Pit lane and alternate course connections are excluded.

north-wilkesboro-speedway.notes: Speedway Motorsports reports 13° after repaving. The Cup Flip card lists 14°.

circuit-of-the-americas-nascar.notes: Numbering from the official facility map, including 6A and 6B. Distance is the NASCAR race distance per lap.

watkins-glen-international-short-course.notes: Short Course with the Inner Loop chicane; the Boot is used by the separate Grand Prix layout.

sonoma-raceway.notes: 1.99-mile Chute layout with the NASCAR hairpin exits shown in the 2026 track map.

lime-rock-park.notes: The Truck diagram and race preview use the Classic layout, without the Uphill and West Bend chicanes.

coronado-street-course.attribution: Centerline redrawn and simplified from Coronado Street Course 2026.png by WL2392, CC BY-SA 4.0.

beijing-street-circuit.method: Centerline traced from official TSL timing map; 12 numbered turns; finish line (not offset start line); intermediate timing lines projected onto diagram.

circuito-da-guia.method: Connected road centerline checked against official Guia layout. Turn badges omitted pending exact geographic numbering verification. Five official timing sectors: 1.600, 1.116, 1.010, 0.945 and 1.449 km. Extended timingSectorEnds preserves a legacy outline without showing fabricated three-sector timing.
